preguntas.porque: Listen! anuncia algo que pasa ahora: presente continuo.

preguntas.enunciado: I usually walk to work, but today I ___ the bus.
preguntas.porque: Today marca algo temporal, distinto de la rutina: presente continuo.

preguntas.traduccion: Ella tiene el pelo negro largo.
preguntas.porque: Para el pelo se usa have, y el tamaño va antes del color.
Sin sustantivo después va el pronombre posesivo: hers.
Pasado de to be con you: were.
Go es irregular: su pasado es went.
Después de didn't el verbo va en forma base.

preguntas.enunciado: I started this job three months ___.
preguntas.porque: «Hace tres meses» es three months ago.

preguntas.enunciado: I was sick, ___ I didn't go to work.
preguntas.porque: No ir a trabajar es el resultado de estar enfermo: so.

preguntas.enunciado: There ___ any cars in the town in 1900.
preguntas.porque: Pasado, plural y negativo: there weren't any.

preguntas.frase: My car is ___ (fast) than your car.
preguntas.porque: Fast es corto: el comparativo es faster.

preguntas.enunciado: It is ___ restaurant in the city.
preguntas.porque: Uno entre todos: superlativo. El de good es the best.
El adverbio de good es well.
Enough va después del adjetivo: long enough.

preguntas.traduccion: Nos vamos a mudar el próximo año.
preguntas.porque: Sujeto + are + going to + verbo + tiempo.

preguntas.enunciado: A: It's hot in here. B: I ___ open the window.
preguntas.porque: Decisión que se toma en el momento: will.
No es necesario trabajar: don't have to.
Después de have va el participio: been.

preguntas.enunciado: You have a fever. You ___ go to work.
preguntas.porque: Es un consejo en negativo: shouldn't.

preguntas.enunciado: Une cada palabra con su traducción.
preguntas.porque: Clima, viajes, compras, agenda y salud: vocabulario de A2.
No parking es prohibido estacionarse; salida es exit y peligro es danger.
Buy es irregular: bought.
El pase de abordar es boarding pass.

preguntas.texto: Last Saturday was Elena's birthday. First, she had breakfast with her parents. Then she went shopping and bought a blue dress. After that, she met her friends at a restaurant. Finally, they went to a concert. It was the best day of the year!
preguntas.porque: «Then she went shopping»: then marca lo que siguió al desayuno.

preguntas.texto: Last Saturday was Elena's birthday. First, she had breakfast with her parents. Then she went shopping and bought a blue dress. After that, she met her friends at a restaurant. Finally, they went to a concert. It was the best day of the year!
preguntas.porque: «Finally, they went to a concert»: finally marca el final.

preguntas.texto: Hotel rules: You must leave your room at twelve on your last day. You mustn't smoke in the rooms. You don't have to bring your luggage to the room: we will do it.
preguntas.porque: «You mustn't smoke in the rooms»: mustn't es prohibición.

preguntas.texto: Hotel rules: You must leave your room at twelve on your last day. You mustn't smoke in the rooms. You don't have to bring your luggage to the room: we will do it.
opciones: Llevar el equipaje a la habitación
Dejar la habitación a las doce
preguntas.porque: «You don't have to bring your luggage to the room»: don't have to es «no es necesario».

preguntas.audio: Are you free tomorrow? No, I'm seeing the doctor at four. Let's meet on Thursday.
preguntas.pregunta: ¿Qué va a hacer mañana a las cuatro?
preguntas.porque: «I'm seeing the doctor at four»: una cita ya agendada.

preguntas.audio: Good evening. I'd like a double room for two nights, please. Would you like breakfast? Yes, please.
preguntas.porque: «For two nights»: dos noches.

preguntas.audio: How was your vacation? It was good, but the weather was bad. It was cold and rainy every day.
preguntas.porque: «It was cold and rainy every day».
